summary: Sun Valley is a world-class alpine destination nestled in Idaho's Boise Mountains, renowned for exceptional skiing, hiking, and stunning scenery across all seasons. This picturesque resort town offers both adrenaline-pumping adventures and peaceful mountain retreats, with a vibrant arts and dining culture that rivals larger mountain destinations.

restaurants.name: Cristina's On Main
restaurants.description: Award-winning restaurant serving contemporary Italian cuisine with an extensive wine list and elegant mountain ambiance. Features house-made pasta and seasonal menus highlighting locally sourced ingredients.
restaurants.mustTry: Handmade pappardelle with wild boar ragù

restaurants.name: The Roundhouse at River Run
restaurants.description: Contemporary American cuisine in a historic mining-era setting with panoramic mountain views and an exceptional wine program. Chef-driven menus emphasize regional flavors and sustainable sourcing.
restaurants.mustTry: Pan-seared king salmon with huckleberry gastrique

restaurants.name: Duckin' Good
restaurants.description: Casual spot famous for its Peking duck, Vietnamese pho, and Asian fusion dishes with bold flavors and reasonable prices. A local favorite that brings international cuisine to the mountains.
restaurants.mustTry: Crispy half Peking duck with mandarin pancakes

restaurants.name: Ketchum Grill
restaurants.description: Upscale steakhouse featuring prime cuts, fresh seafood, and an impressive wine cellar with over 3,000 selections. Offers an intimate dining experience with refined service.
restaurants.mustTry: Prime dry-aged ribeye with wild mushroom risotto

restaurants.name: Kneadery
restaurants.description: Popular bakery and breakfast spot offering fresh pastries, soups, sandwiches, and coffee in a casual, welcoming atmosphere. Perfect for quick fuel before outdoor adventures.

restaurants.name: Rusty Parrot Lodge Restaurant
restaurants.description: Contemporary American cuisine in a cozy lodge setting with warm fireplace ambiance and mountain views. Known for hearty portions and excellent cocktails.
restaurants.mustTry: Pan-seared duck breast with blackberry gastrique

restaurants.name: Eberhard's Cafe
restaurants.description: Charming cafe serving European-inspired breakfast, lunch, and pastries with a focus on quality ingredients and homemade preparations. Offers outdoor seating with mountain views.
restaurants.mustTry: Swiss muesli and fresh fruit crepes

restaurants.name: Sawtooth Tavern
restaurants.description: Casual mountain pub with hearty comfort food, craft beers, and a lively atmosphere perfect for après-ski dining. Features wood-fired pizza and local microbrews.

restaurants.name: Warm Springs Ranch Restaurant
restaurants.description: Ranch-to-table cuisine highlighting locally raised meats and seasonal produce in an authentic ranch setting. Offers scenic views and a more intimate dining experience.
restaurants.mustTry: Grass-fed beef short ribs with roasted root vegetables

restaurants.name: Perry's
restaurants.description: Sophisticated destination restaurant with French-inspired cooking and an impressive wine program featuring European selections. Elegant setting and impeccable service.
restaurants.mustTry: Dover sole meunière with brown butter

restaurants.name: Panda Restaurant
restaurants.description: Affordable Asian cuisine featuring authentic Chinese and Thai dishes with generous portions. Popular with locals for quick, flavorful meals.
restaurants.mustTry: Chicken pad thai and spring rolls

restaurants.name: Globaltrotter Grill
restaurants.description: International cuisine with a rotating menu featuring flavors from around the world, casual atmosphere, and reasonable prices. Known for fresh ingredients and creative preparations.

activities.name: Skiing at Bald Mountain
activities.description: World-class ski resort with over 2,000 acres of terrain ranging from beginner to advanced slopes, featuring excellent snow conditions and varied mountain runs. Home to numerous ski schools and rentals for all levels.

activities.name: Hiking in the Sawtooth Mountains
activities.description: Extensive network of scenic trails offering views of pristine alpine lakes, meadows, and rugged peaks. Options range from easy valley walks to challenging summit hikes.

activities.name: Trail Creek Cabin Backcountry Skiing
activities.description: Remote backcountry skiing experience with guided tours through pristine powder and mountain scenery, accessible via snowcat or on skis. Offers solitude and challenging terrain for experienced skiers.

activities.name: Fly Fishing in Silver Creek
activities.description: Premier fly fishing destination in Idaho with world-class trout fishing in clear mountain waters. Professional guides available for half or full-day excursions.

activities.name: Mountain Biking Trail System
activities.description: Extensive network of well-maintained trails ranging from beginner to advanced with stunning valley and mountain views. Bike rentals and guided tours available throughout summer.

activities.name: Horseback Riding in the Mountains
activities.description: Guided horseback tours through scenic mountain valleys and forested areas, suitable for all experience levels. Offers an authentic mountain experience with knowledgeable wranglers.

activities.name: Scenic Chairlift Rides
activities.description: Summer chairlift rides at Bald Mountain providing easy access to alpine meadows with wildflowers and panoramic views. Perfect for non-skiers to experience mountain scenery.

activities.name: Sun Valley Museum of Art
activities.description: Regional art museum featuring contemporary works, historical pieces, and rotating exhibitions showcasing regional and international artists. Located in downtown Ketchum with beautiful gallery spaces.

activities.name: Wildflower Meadow Walking Tour
activities.description: Guided or self-guided walks through alpine meadows during peak wildflower season offering photography opportunities and botanical education. Best from July through August.

activities.name: Snowmobiling Adventures
activities.description: Guided snowmobile tours through backcountry terrain, offering thrilling winter experiences with professional guides and equipment provided. Multiple packages available for different skill levels.

activities.name: Downtown Ketchum Art Walk and Shopping
activities.description: Self-guided exploration of downtown galleries, boutique shops, and public art installations with regular First Friday events. Free activity showcasing local artists and creative community.

activities.name: Whitewater Rafting on Salmon River
activities.description: Half or full-day guided rafting experiences on pristine river sections ranging from gentle floats to exciting rapids. Knowledgeable guides provide historical and ecological commentary.

spots.name: Bald Mountain Summit
spots.description: Panoramic alpine vistas with surrounding peaks, valleys, and seasonal wildflower displays creating stunning landscape photography opportunities.
spots.bestTime: Early morning for golden hour, summer for wildflowers

spots.name: Silver Creek Fly Fishing Scene
spots.description: Clear mountain stream with dramatic reflections, fly fishers in waders, and pristine riparian vegetation perfect for nature and action photography.
spots.bestTime: Early morning or late afternoon golden hour

spots.name: Sawtooth Lake Reflection
spots.description: Picture-perfect alpine lake with mirror reflections of jagged peaks and evergreen forests, ideal for landscape and long-exposure photography.
spots.bestTime: Pre-dawn for stars and sunrise reflections

spots.name: Trail Creek Cabin
spots.description: Historic backcountry cabin set against snow-covered peaks, offering authentic mountain architecture and dramatic seasonal transformations.
spots.bestTime: Winter for pristine snow scenes, summer for wildflower framing

spots.name: Downtown Ketchum Main Street
spots.description: Tree-lined street with historic storefronts, galleries, and mountain backdrop providing excellent street photography and architectural details.
spots.bestTime: Golden hour for warm street light

spots.name: Aspen Grove in Fall
spots.description: Dense aspen trees with brilliant golden foliage creating natural patterns and textures ideal for autumn color and forest photography.

spots.name: Snow Gull Chairlift Views
spots.description: Elevated vantage point overlooking ski runs, valleys, and distant peaks with accessible scenic compositions from the chairlift.
spots.bestTime: Clear days with good snow visibility

spots.name: Wildlife in Alpine Meadows
spots.description: Opportunities to photograph mountain goats, marmots, pikas, and other alpine fauna in natural habitat with peak season being summer.
spots.bestTime: Early morning hours during summer months

spots.name: Bald Mountain Night Sky
spots.description: Dark sky location ideal for astrophotography and nightscape work with minimal light pollution and panoramic celestial views.
spots.bestTime: New moon nights during clear weather

spots.name: Warm Springs Resort Architecture
spots.description: Modern mountain architecture with glass and wood elements reflecting natural landscape, excellent for architectural and contemporary design photography.

lensRecommendations: 24-70mm f/2.8 for versatile landscape and architectural work capturing varied compositions
70-200mm f/4 for wildlife and telephoto detail work isolating subjects in mountain scenery
14-24mm f/2.8 ultra-wide angle for sweeping vistas and immersive alpine panoramas
100mm f/2.8 macro lens for wildflower and small details with shallow depth of field
photography.goldenHourNotes: Sun Valley's high alpine elevation creates extended golden hours with warm light lasting 45-60 minutes before sunrise and after sunset. The clear mountain air provides exceptionally crisp light with minimal atmospheric haze. Both morning and evening light cast dramatic shadows across the mountain terrain, creating excellent depth and dimension for landscape photography.

weather.seasonality: Sun Valley features distinct seasons with winter (December-February) offering world-class skiing with abundant snowfall, while summer (June-August) provides excellent hiking, wildflowers, and outdoor recreation. Spring and fall are transitional with pleasant weather, fewer crowds, and beautiful scenery.
weather.summary: The high alpine elevation creates a cool mountain climate with cold winters averaging -5°C and mild summers around 24°C. Annual snowfall exceeds 300 inches, making winter the primary season for snow sports, while summer offers warm days perfect for hiking and outdoor activities.

hotels.name: Sun Valley Lodge
hotels.description: Iconic historic lodge featuring upscale accommodations, world-class dining, spa services, and direct ski access with warm hospitality and mountain elegance.

hotels.name: Rusty Parrot Lodge
hotels.description: Charming boutique lodge in downtown location with comfortable rooms, excellent restaurant, fireplace lounge, and walking distance to galleries and shops.

hotels.name: Tamarack Lodge
hotels.description: Affordable lodge offering clean, comfortable rooms with basic amenities, convenient location near downtown, and friendly service for budget-conscious travelers.
